name: e3-tiled-1024
question: Does real detail from 1024px views (2x2 overlapping 640px tiles) recover small litter? Justified by the baseline diagnosis: TACO test recall is 9% at 8-16 px vs 68% at 32 px and over, and 61% of Pune regions are under 16 px at 640 (41% at 1024). Data: litter-v2-r1024 (TACO at 1024 scale + all labelled Pune views at 1024 cut into tiles). Model follows E1 unless E2 has already beaten it; edit model/pretrained before running.
